title: Bowl of Ukrainian Pinto Bean Stew
description: A hearty and comforting Ukrainian-inspired stew made with pinto beans, vegetables, and a hint of citrus.
instructions: In a large pot or Dutch oven, sauté the chopped onion, carrot, and celery in a little water until tender.
Add the rinsed and drained pinto beans, lemon juice, and enough water to cover the beans.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the beans are tender.
Stir in the sour cream and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
